leftEvidence.title: Leaders remember the third-day claim and secure the tomb against a disciple report

points.label: Leaders and authorities
points.left: Chief priests and Pharisees approach Pilate for authorization, a guard, and a seal.
points.right: Chief priests and elders deliberate, pay guards, and promise protection with the governor.

points.label: Report logic
points.left: The feared future claim is that disciples might steal the body and say Jesus rose.
points.right: The instructed public claim is that disciples stole the body while guards slept.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Leaders pay guards to circulate the report they had anticipated

payload.tension: The same theft explanation appears first as a feared scenario and later as a purchased account after the guards report what happened.
payload.title: Tomb secured / counter-report purchased
